asks: What happens when the record reaches its size limit?
answer: You set a size limit. When it is reached, bulky content goes: recordings first, then message text, the oldest first in each. The lines that point to it stay, and a fact says what was removed. No fact or report is removed to make room. The default limit is set once `record-disk-size` is measured. What happens when the lines alone reach the limit is `record-full-after-bulk`.

sets.says: No fact or report is removed to make room.
